name: measurement__notifier_engine_path
description: Locks the production measurement-notifier callback wiring end-to-end: a fake Temperature source's OnMatterValueChanged fires → wireMeasurementListeners' callback dirty-marks the subscription via mgr.OnAttributeChanged → engine drain → reportSubscription ships ReportData on a fresh exchange → peer acks → status_ack logs. Catches any regression in the wireMeasurementListenersLocked → notifier.OnMatterValueChanged → manager.OnAttributeChanged chain, which sits between the model layer's value events and the bridge's wire output. F2's per-cluster narrowing is exercised at unit level (filterPathsByNotifierCluster) — measurement-source notifiers intentionally fall through to the full path set per the design comment in subscribe.go.
